stories.title: US sending additional forces to Israel as potential escalation looms
stories.summary: The US is deploying additional forces to Israel as a hedge against possible escalation involving Iran ahead of elections in both countries. Roughly 3,000 US troops are already stationed across Israel.

stories.title: Netanyahu orders security review of international flights after FlyDubai cockpit attack
stories.summary: The prime minister of Israel ordered a comprehensive security review of all international flights to Israel after an Omani co-pilot attacked the captain on a Dubai flight. Authorities say the co-pilot intended to crash the plane into Ben Gurion Airport.

stories.title: MoralityBench.ai launches 13-model moral psychology leaderboard
stories.summary: A new moral-psychology benchmark ranked 13 AI models, with DeepSeek V4.1 Flash leading while Jev topped consistency. The launch adds a moral-evaluation dimension to the broader model-benchmarking race.

stories.title: OpenAI Jev model reverse-engineered as a compact 4-9B active-param system
stories.summary: Independent analysis suggests the widely-discussed OpenAI Jev model is a compact mixture-of-experts system using only roughly 4-9 billion active parameters rather than a frontier-scale model. The writeup reached the Hacker News front page on Sunday.

stories.title: Denzel Ward interception flips momentum in 27-24 win over Steelers
stories.summary: Cornerback Denzel Ward intercepted a pass to swing momentum for a Browns defense that used rush and coverage to force key stops in the 27-24 win over Pittsburgh. It was one of three big takeaways from the game.

stories.title: Deshaun Watson throws for 268 yards in win over Steelers
stories.summary: Watson threw for 268 yards in the 27-24 victory, helping the offense build on a second straight win. The numbers underscore a steadier stretch for the passing game.

stories.title: Browns beat Steelers 27-24 in Week 4
stories.summary: Cleveland moved to 2-2 with a 27-24 win over Pittsburgh, leaning on a defense that forced key stops and turnovers. Defensive lineman Mason Graham left the game and did not return.

stories.title: Jeremiah Smith breaks Ohio State receiving records in 31-14 win at Iowa
stories.summary: Jeremiah Smith became the Ohio State all-time leader in career receptions (207) and touchdown catches (36), adding 11 catches for 206 yards in a 31-14 win at No. 14 Iowa. He now holds all three of the major receiving records.

stories.title: Hamilton recovers to podium as Antonelli edges closer to a first title
stories.summary: Lewis Hamilton fought back to third at Sepang behind Verstappen and Antonelli, while a late power-unit failure by George Russell boosted the championship charge of Antonelli. A chaotic, storm-delayed start defined the race.

stories.title: Verstappen wins rain-hit Bahrain GP in Malaysia, Red Bull first win of 2026
stories.summary: Max Verstappen converted pole into victory in a rain-delayed Bahrain Grand Prix held at Sepang, beating Kimi Antonelli after George Russell retired late. It is his and Red Bull first win of the season.

stories.title: One dead, one injured in overnight East Side shooting
stories.summary: Columbus police found two shooting victims on the 900 block of Barnett Road early Oct. 4; both were taken to a hospital in critical condition and one was pronounced dead shortly after. The incident remains under investigation.

stories.title: Semi-truck carrying frozen food catches fire on I-270
stories.summary: Lanes on I-270 North near mile marker 10 were shut down after a semi hauling about 30,000 pounds of frozen food caught fire in Columbus; no one was hurt and the cause is under investigation.
